context: Request: across signed Banking & Finance deals, how often EBITDA add-backs were conceded in sponsor-controlled vs strategic-corporate borrower deals, with buckets, add-back status and rates. Rubric: 6 of 8 sponsor deals (75%) and 3 of 4 corporate deals (75%); add-back matters 1005-00001, 1006-00001, 1012-00001, 1043-00001, 1019-00002, 1042-00001 (sponsor) and 1021-00001, 1038-00002, 1010-00001 (corporate); precision criterion. The corporate no-add-back deal is 1013-00001 (Genome DX bridge loan); 1003-00003 (VeloPay), 1012-00002 and 1020-00002 (Greenfield DIP) are outside the qualifying set.

stages.note: Whole-store glob in parallel with a folder listing cut at 120 lines and file counts by extension; the review says not to treat it as a full list.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Three find | grep passes over all paths for financing, add-back and ownership words, each cut by its own sed line limit; the review flags the caps.

stages.note: A store-wide extraction script and a range-bounded rerun both time out; it inspects partial output files. The review flags the incomplete coverage.

runs.failure_point: It counted extra signed deals and a court-approved facility as deals with add-backs, so both rates and the precision check fail.

first_error.why: Its sponsor bucket counts ten deals with add-backs in nine, including deals outside the signed set it should count and a deal whose add-back status its documents do not support, and its corporate bucket counts a court-approved facility as having add-backs (evidence seen at [41]-[64]).
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The check review [81] asked whether the court-approved facility belongs in the corporate bucket; the agent added a sensitivity note but kept counting it, and no review questioned the extra sponsor deals.

runs.failure_point: Its 16-deal set counts non-qualifying facilities with add-backs and puts two sponsor deals in the corporate bucket.

first_error.why: Its 16-deal set counts a draft-era sponsor deal, a second facility of one borrower and a court-approved facility as signed deals with add-backs (evidence seen at [47]-[67]), inflating both buckets.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) Review [71] named the court-approved facility and a draft read as unclear inclusions; the agent kept them in the table and the write.

other_errors.why: It puts two sponsor-controlled deals in the corporate bucket although it had read their agreements at [56]-[63]; its per-matter table at [80] already carried wrong buckets.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) Review [89] said the controlling-owner classification could not be confirmed and parallel reads might be mispaired; the check stage edited rows but kept both buckets.

divergence: All three runs failed, all finding every needed add-back deal through store-wide file-name searches and chunked scans, then reading executed agreements. They split on how the population was fixed. T0 and T2 counted too many deals as signed deals with add-backs (over-inclusion at the write stage; T2 also put two sponsor deals in the corporate bucket after mispaired parallel reads). T1 fixed a hand-picked list after its scans and left out a corporate deal that its own file-name search had shown (incomplete population at the last scan stage). In every run a review named the matter or list at fault (the court-approved facility in T0 and T2, the hand-picked list in T1) and the agent kept its set; label notes were ignored twice in T0 and once in T2.
